Statistics: Total number of not blank m/zs
Description: Total number of not blank m/zs in the final table (BLANKS_TOTAL == 0).

Statistics: Total number of not blank and not bed m/zs
Description: Total number of not bed (not culture media) m/zs over the not blank m/zs, BEDS_TOTAL == 0.

Statistics: Number of m/zs identified in GNPS curated and spectral identification rate
Description: Total number of not blank and not bed m/zs that were identified against the GNPS libraries (gnps_category != 'out'). And its percentage over the total number of not blank and not bed m/zs - the spectral identification rate.

Statistics: Number of unique GNPS identifications curated and GNPS coverage
Description: Total number of unique GNPS identifications from not blank and not bed m/zs that passed the curation (unique gnps_Smiles with gnps_category != 'out') - unique identified molecules and its percentage over the total number of unique SMILES in GNPS from April 2026 (unique gnps_Smiles for gnps_category != 'out' over 90253 compounds for GNPS total unique SMILES) - the GNPS coverage.

Statistics: Number of m/zs identified in GNPS all and spectral identification rate
Description: Total number of all not blank and not bed m/zs that were identified against the GNPS libraries (gnps_Smiles != NA). And its percentage over the total number of not blank and not bed m/zs - the spectral identification rate.

Statistics: Number of unique GNPS identifications all and GNPS coverage
Description: Total number of unique GNPS identifications from all not blank and not bed m/zs (unique gnps_Smiles that are not NA) - unique identified molecules and its percentage over the total number of unique SMILES in GNPS from April 2026 (90253 compounds for GNPS total unique SMILES) - the GNPS coverage.
Total number of not blank and not bed m/zs that were selected as [M+H]+ (protonated_representative == 1) - putative molecules. And its percentage over the total number of not blank and not bed m/zs.

Statistics: Number of [M+H]+ m/zs identified in GNPS curated and spectral identification rate
Description: Total number of not blank and not bed [M+H]+ m/zs that were identified against the GNPS and passed the curation (gnps_category != 'out'). And its percentage over the total number of not blank and not bed [M+H]+ m/zs.

Statistics: Number of putative novel [M+H]+ m/zs in GNPS curated
Description: Total number of not blank and not bed [M+H]+ m/zs that were NOT identified against the GNPS or did not pass the curation (gnps_category == 'out'), thus, may represent putative novel compounds not present in the database. And its percentage over the total number of not blank and not bed [M+H]+ m/zs - the spectral identification rate.

Statistics: Number of unique curated identifications of the [M+H]+ m/zs and their GNPS coverage
Description: The number of unique and curated identifications in GNPS for the not blank and not bed [M+H]+ m/zs and its percentage over the total number of unique SMILES in GNPS from April 2026 (unique gnps_Smiles not NA for gnps_category != 'out' over 90253 compounds for GNPS total unique SMILES) - the GNPS coverage by [M+H]+.

Statistics: Chemical diversity of [M+H]+ in GNPS Superclasses curated
Description: The unique number of superclasses that got identified by the not blank and not bed [M+H]+ m/zs in GNPS. And its percentage over the total number of unique superclasses considered (94 for GNPS using NPClassifier).

Statistics: Chemical diversity of [M+H]+ in GNPS Superclasses grouping curated
Description: The unique number of superclasses grouping that got identified by the not blank and not bed [M+H]+ m/zs in GNPS. And its percentage over the total number of unique superclasses grouping considered (10 groups proposed by NP3 from the NPClassifier superclasses without the not annotated ones).

Statistics: Number of [M+H]+ m/zs identified in GNPS all and spectral identification rate
Description: Total number of all not blank and not bed [M+H]+ m/zs that were identified against the GNPS libraries (gnps_SpectrumID is not NA). And its percentage over the total number of not blank and not bed [M+H]+ m/zs - the spectral identification rate.

Statistics: Number of putative novel [M+H]+ m/zs in GNPS all
Description: Total number of not blank and not bed [M+H]+ m/zs that were NOT identified against the GNPS (gnps_SpectrumID is NA), thus, may represent putative novel compounds not present in the database. And its percentage over the total number of not blank and not bed [M+H]+ m/zs - the spectral identification rate.

Statistics: Number of unique GNPS identifications all of the [M+H]+ m/zs and GNPS coverage
Description: Total number of unique GNPS identifications from all not blank and not bed [M+H]+ m/zs (unique gnps_Smiles that are not NA) - unique identified molecules and its percentage over the total number of unique SMILES in GNPS from April 2026 (unique gnps_Smiles that are not NA over 90253 compounds for GNPS total unique SMILES) - the GNPS coverage.

Statistics: Chemical diversity of [M+H]+ in GNPS Superclasses all clean
Description: The unique number of superclasses that got identified by the not blank and not bed [M+H]+ m/zs in GNPS. And its percentage over the total number of unique superclasses considered (94 for GNPS using NPClassifier).

Statistics: Chemical diversity of [M+H]+ in GNPS Superclasses grouping all clean
Description: The unique number of superclasses grouping that got identified by the not blank and not bed [M+H]+ m/zs in GNPS. And its percentage over the total number of unique superclasses grouping considered (10 groups proposed by NP3 from the NPClassifier superclasses without the not annotated ones).
